item.title: Re: Saint Bernard (seeking greenlights)
item.content:encoded:
1) What you have under "Central Narrative" should actually go under "Page Type". The Hook and Elevator Pitch are fine.

2) Kill the Additional Notes; if you're not sure it's a friendly dog and you're the one writing it, then you're wasting people's time. Decide one way or another.

3) SCP-2137 usually only worries about serial killers or other major criminals. If the dog is mentioned by it, then there needs to an actual reason for it, and that should be interesting.

4) The story behind the St. Bernard needs some serious work. Prior history would be nice, such as how long it has been around, some theories as to how it gained its abilities, and even some stories about why it does what it does. We need some details, and there aren't any here.

item.content:encoded:
cold slurpee, per the required forum guidelines, please use the standardized template for concepts found here: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282684/required-reading:how-to-use-this-forum-ideas

Please remember to be mindful that the combined text of the last four sections1 of the template may not exceed 400 words. For convenience, authors can check wordcount using this site: https://wordcounter.net/

Once you have reviewed the guidelines, please edit your post to the correct format rather than creating a new thread, and if you are having trouble editing, click the "edit" function under the "options" tab to the lower right of your post. Please feel free to then reach out to a reviewer for your concept: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282692/how-to-get-more-reviews

Footnotes
1. Elevator Pitch, Central Narrative, Hook/Attention-Grabber, and Additional Notes

item.title: Saint Bernard (seeking greenlights)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Drama/Emotional

Page Layout (Optional): Standard SCP Article format

Elevator Pitch: Ageless Saint Bernard dog that causes St Bernard and religious hallucination in criminals.

Central Narrative: SCP is relatively standard format wise, however there will be addendums like
-Retrieval log
-Email requesting reclassification scp from euclid to safe
-Addendum that could possibly cross reference SCP-2137 (tupac) and MTF's named.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: This SCP is a classic innocent happy cute thing with a bit of a more dark side, while I don't think it will necessary stand out based off that alone, but I think its an interesting twist on it.

Additional Notes: Im pretty sure this SCP is safe as it is just a normal really friendly dog, but i'm not 100% sure.
